units.source_text: “狗的世界还是在女子大学时代。

en.t: “The world of dogs is still in its women’s-college age.

units.source_text: 不过说实在的，也许养狗在科学方面发展得远为迅速。

en.t: But to tell the truth, perhaps dog breeding has advanced far more rapidly in scientific terms.

units.source_text: 优良品种的狗在婚姻交配上，一味坚持优生学嘛。

en.t: When it comes to mating fine breeds of dogs, people simply insist on eugenics.

units.source_text: 人难得掌握了优生学，却不能让这门学术为人本身发挥作用，

en.t: Human beings have finally managed to grasp eugenics, yet they cannot put this science to work for humanity itself,

units.source_text: 而是运用在家畜的改良上了。”

en.t: and instead have applied it to improving livestock.”

units.source_text: （凯撒的物当归凯撒，神的物当归给神。

en.t: (Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and unto God the things that are God’s.

units.source_text: 阴间的权柄不能胜过他。）

en.t: The powers of the underworld shall not prevail against him.)
